modules.title: Introduction to Polynomials and Partial Fractions
modules.html:
Polynomial division, the factor theorem and partial fractions. This section covers introduction to polynomials and partial fractions.

Key points

  • Resolve $$ \frac{1}{x^2 - 1} $$ into partial fractions. — $$ \frac{1}{2(x-1)} - \frac{1}{2(x+1)} $$.
  • Resolve $$\frac{5x - 1}{(x-1)(x+1)}$$ into partial fractions. — $$\frac{2}{x-1} + \frac{3}{x+1}$$.
  • Resolve $$\frac{3x - 1}{(x-1)(x+2)}$$ into partial fractions. — $$\frac{2}{3(x-1)} + \frac{7}{3(x+2)}$$.
  • Resolve $$ \frac{1}{x^2 - 4} $$ into partial fractions. — $$ \frac{1}{4(x-2)} - \frac{1}{4(x+2)} $$.
  • Partial Frac $$ 1/(x^2-1) $$: — $$ A/(x-1) + B/(x+1) $$.

Worked examples

Q: Resolve $$ \frac{1}{x^2 - 1} $$ into partial fractions.
A: $$ \frac{1}{2(x-1)} - \frac{1}{2(x+1)} $$ — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: $$ \frac{1}{2(x-1)} - \frac{1}{2(x+1)} $$.

Q: Resolve $$\frac{5x - 1}{(x-1)(x+1)}$$ into partial fractions.
A: $$\frac{2}{x-1} + \frac{3}{x+1}$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$\frac{2}{x-1} + \frac{3}{x+1}$$.
